programme.title: When Sharks Attack
programme.desc: Twice Bitten: Two unlucky ocean lovers defy the odds when each of them is attacked twice by sharks. Experts look for clues to connect the rare attacks. (S8, ep 4)

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Minkus Stinkus: Dr Oakley heads to the Kroschel Wildlife Centre to treat a moose with limb issues and a mink that cannot stop sneezing. (S8, ep 7) 7+

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Ready, Vet, Go!: Dr Pol and his son set out to solve a mystery, as 10 Angus steers have suddenly gone lame and are struggling to stand. (S2, ep 11)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Rock N' Pol: After the emergency farm calls and clinic visits for the week are complete, the Pols kick off their Fourth of July celebrations with a parade and a barbecue! (S2, ep 12)

programme.title: Big Cat Odyssey
programme.desc: Discover the story of Dereck and Beverly Joubert, who set out over 30 years ago to understand big cats, battling floods and droughts along the way. 7+.

programme.title: Future Cats
programme.desc: Experts let their imaginations run wild when, with the help of cutting-edge special effects, they visualise what could be in store for our feline friends. 7+

programme.title: Diary Of A Teen Leopard
programme.desc: Impatient, headstrong teenager Pemba should be independent but still relies on his mother. When she's injured, can he sever the apron strings and face his fears? 7+

programme.title: Desert Lions: Skeleton Coast
programme.desc: Desert Lions: Skeleton Coast - Lion researcher Dr Philip Stander follows three orphaned lion cubs from birth to adulthood as they navigate the complexity of survival. (S1, ep 1) 7+

programme.title: Russia's Wild Tiger
programme.desc: Join a young Siberian tiger as he leaves his mother for the first time and takes on the huge challenges that have driven his kind towards extinction in Russia's Far East.

programme.title: Jaguar Beach Battle
programme.desc: Filipe DeAndrade heads to a beach in Costa Rica, where America's largest cat, the jaguar, is hunting a rather unusual prey - sea turtles.

programme.title: Hammerhead Sharks Up Close With Bertie Gregory
programme.desc: Bertie Gregory is back and this time, he's searching for one of the world's most distinctive sharks, the hammerhead. 7+

programme.title: New: Critter Fixers: Country Vets
programme.desc: Tip Top Techs: The Critter Fixers train their techs while treating a pregnant bulldog, a goat, an emu, a boxer and an axolotl. (S6, ep 2)

programme.title: New: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: The Princess and the Paw-Per: Drs. Ben and Erin organise a charity 5K while treating a puppy's abscess, a farm dog's injured paw and a llama's infected toe. (S5, ep 5)

programme.title: New: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: Adventures to New Worlds: Early Pacific voyagers brave the open ocean, using the stars and sea to discover new islands and build thriving communities. (S1, ep 1)

programme.title: New: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: Beyond the Horizon: Pacific voyagers reach Tahiti, Easter Island, Hawai'i and New Zealand before European arrival changes their world forever. (S1, ep 2)

programme.title: Blitzkrieg Sharks
programme.desc: A look at the surprising predatory behaviour of sharks. Previously thought to rule only beneath the waves, evidence suggests they are now preying on birds, moose and even polar bears. 12+

programme.title: Killer Shark Vs Killer Whale
programme.desc: Around the world, Orcas have been attacking great whites. Shockingly, when these attacks occur, other sharks start to move away. Are they communicating with each other about the attacks? 7+

programme.title: Shark Attack 360
programme.desc: Dangerous Forces: Diva uncovers a spate of shark bites from across the world, all happening within a few days - so the team tries to understand what connects them. 12+. (S2, ep 2)
